caption: The drawing depicts a puppet-like figure of a woman holding a baby. The woman has a yellow face with visible facial features including black eyebrows, eyes, a pointed nose, blush spots on her cheeks, and red lips. She is wearing a tall white cap on her head, a green ruffled collar, a red long-sleeved top, and a large, patterned apron-type garment over a full skirt which has floral or abstract color patches in shades of green, blue, pink, and red. In her arms, she cradles a smaller doll representing a baby wrapped in a long, flowing white blanket or cloth. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and the artist’s signature, “Geo. J. File,” is located near the lower right corner.
title: Hand Puppet "Judy" and Child
